title: refactor: require community model titles
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Backfills legacy titles from the existing title, description, or model slug
- Makes the community listing title column required
- Removes runtime title fallbacks from the catalog, dashboard, and agents API
- Adds migration coverage for all backfill paths

gist.headline: Every flower gets a name
gist.blurb: Community models now arrive with proper name tags instead of making the catalog guess. Polli has put the label maker somewhere safe, allegedly.
gist.summary: Community model listing titles are now required, with a migration that backfills legacy titles from each model's existing title, description, or slug and removes catalog, dashboard, and Agents API fallback logic.
gist.impact: Community models will show consistent titles across the catalog, dashboard, and Agents API, including older entries that previously depended on runtime fallbacks.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy community-model garden where every code-flower has a clear pixel nameplate, representing required and backfilled titles. Polli, wearing a tiny librarian hat, carefully labels a previously unnamed plant while a helpful CRT monitor robot holds a roster of model names.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art community-model garden where the main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny librarian hat and attaches clear nameplates to code-flowers while a cute chunky CRT monitor robot holds a list of model titles. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley, with subtle pixel-font text reading "TITLED".
